verbatim_quote.english_translation: We need OpenCode in serve mode, not service mode. Update repo and globally and restart. OpenChamber always use existing OpenCode, never run any instance. Remove compress plugin locally and globally. Create a task for them and all other existing working changes.

extracted_decision.summary: Switch OpenCode to serve mode only, pin OpenChamber to the existing server, remove DCP plugin locally and globally, and create a task covering all working changes.
extracted_decision.rationale: Avoid multiple OpenCode instances and simplify plugin management by using a single fixed serve-mode server that OpenChamber reuses.
alternatives: Allow OpenChamber to spawn its own OpenCode instance
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Stopping the background service may disrupt CLI/agent sessions; DCP removal changes compression behavior; staging unrelated working changes widens review scope.
